<h>Lectio 1</h>
De Isaía Prophéta
<r>Isa 25:1-4</r>
<n>1</n> Dómine, Deus meus es tu; exaltábo te, et confitébor nómini tuo: quóniam fecísti mirabília, cogitatiónes antíquas fidéles. Amen.
<n>2</n> Quia posuísti civitátem in túmulum, urbem fortem in ruínam, domum alienórum: ut non sit cívitas, et in sempitérnum non ædificétur.
<n>3</n> Super hoc laudábit te pópulus fortis; cívitas géntium robustárum timébit te:
<n>4</n> Quia factus es fortitúdo páuperi, fortitúdo egéno in tribulatióne sua, spes a túrbine, umbráculum ab æstu.
<h>H</h>æc dicit Dóminus Deus: Convertímini ad me, et salvi éritis.
<r>℟.</r> Deo grátias.

<r>℟.</r> Egrediétur Dóminus de Samaría ad portam, quæ réspicit ad Oriéntem: et véniet in Béthlehem ámbulans super aquas redemptiónis Iudæ:
* Tunc salvus erit omnis homo: quia ecce véniet.
<r>℣.</r> Et præparábitur in misericórdia sólium eius, et sedébit super illud in veritáte.
<r>℟.</r> Tunc salvus erit omnis homo: quia ecce véniet.

<h>Reading 1</h>
Lesson from the book of Isaias
<r>Isa 25:1-4</r>
<n>1</n> O Lord, thou art my God, I will exalt thee, and give glory to thy name: for thou hast done wonderful things, thy designs of old faithful, amen.
<n>2</n> For thou hast reduced the city to a heap, the strong city to ruin, the house of strangers, to be no city, and to be no more built up for ever.
<n>3</n> Therefore shall a strong people praise thee, the city of mighty nations shall fear thee.
<n>4</n> Because thou hast been a strength to the poor, a strength to the needy in his distress: a refuge from the whirlwind, a shadow from the heat.
<h>H</h>æc dicit Dóminus Deus: Convertímini ad me, et salvi éritis.
<r>℟.</r> Thanks be to God.

<r>℟.</r> The Lord shall go forth out of Samaria unto the gate that looketh toward the East; and He shall come into Bethlehem, walking upon the waters of the redemption of Judah.
* Then shall every one be saved for, behold, He cometh.
<r>℣.</r> And in mercy shall His throne be established, and He shall sit upon it in truth.
<r>℟.</r> Then shall every one be saved for, behold, He cometh.

b.6b1a6f9862:
<h>Martyrologium</h>
<c>Q</c>uarto Idus Decémbris Luna prima. Anno Dómini 2026
<h>S</h>ancti Melchíadis, Papæ et Mártyris, cuius dies natális recensétur tértio Idus Ianuárii.
<h>R</h>omæ, via Ostiénsi, Dedicátio Basílicæ sancti Pauli Apóstoli; quæ, simul cum Dedicatióne Basílicæ sancti Petri, Apostolórum Príncipis, annua celebritate recólitur quartodécimo Kaléndas Decémbris.
<h>E</h>ódem die sanctórum Mártyrum Carpóphori Presbýteri, et Abúndii Diáconi; qui, in Diocletiáni persecutióne, primo fústibus crudelíssime cæsi, deínde in cárcerem, negáto cibo et potu, retrúsi, et rursum in equúleo torti, et post hæc diu in cárcere maceráti, novíssime gládio percússi sunt.
<h>A</h>lexandríæ sanctórum Mártyrum Mennæ, Hermógenis et Eugraphi; qui sub Galério Maximiáno passi sunt.
<h>A</h>pud Leontínos, in Sicília, sanctórum Mártyrum Mercúrii et Sociórum mílitum; qui, sub Tertýllo Prǽside, témpore Licínii Imperatóris, gládio cæsi sunt.
<h>A</h>ncýræ, in Galátia, sancti Gemélli Mártyris, qui, post dira torménta, sub Iuliáno Apóstata, crucis supplício martýrium consummávit.
<h>E</h>méritæ, in Hispánia, pássio sanctæ Euláliæ Vírginis, quæ, sub Maximiáno Imperatóre, cum esset annórum duódecim, ibi, iussu Daciáni Prǽsidis, pro confessióne Christi, plúrima torménta est perpéssa; novíssime, in equúleo suspénsa et exunguláta, fáculis ardéntibus ex utróque látere appósitis, hausto igne, spíritum réddidit.
<h>I</h>tem ibídem sanctæ Iúliæ, Vírginis et Mártyris; quæ beátæ Euláliæ sócia fuit, et illi ad passiónem properánti indivídua comes adhǽsit.
<h>R</h>omæ beáti Gregórii Papæ Tértii, qui sanctitáte meritísque præclárus migrávit in cælum.
<h>V</h>iénnæ, in Gállia, sancti Sindúlphi, Epíscopi et Confessóris.
<h>B</h>ríxiæ sancti Deúsdedit Epíscopi.
<h>L</h>auréti, in Picéno, Translátio sacræ Domus Genitrícis Dei Maríæ, qua in domo Verbum caro factum est. Ipsam vero beatíssimam Vírginem, Lauretánæ título nuncupátam, Benedíctus Papa Décimus quintus ómnibus aëreonáutis præcípuam apud Deum Patrónam attríbuit.
<r>℣.</r> Et álibi aliórum plurimórum sanctórum Mártyrum et Confessórum, atque sanctárum Vírginum.
<r>℟.</r> Deo grátias.
b.9ee68c98be:
<h>Martyrology</h>
<c>D</c>ecember 10th 2026, the 1st day of the Moon, were born into the better life:

<h>A</h>t Rome, the holy Pope Melchiades, (who reigned three years, 7 months, and 62 days, from the year 310 till January 10, 314,) who suffered much in the persecution under the Emperor Maximian, but fell asleep in the Lord after peace had been restored to the church.
<h>A</h>t Rome, upon the Ostian Way, the Dedication of the Basilica of the holy Apostle Paul, which is kept every year together with the Dedication of the Basilica of holy Peter, Prince of the Apostles, upon the 18th day of November.
<h>U</h>pon the same day the holy martyrs Carpophorus the Priest, and Abundius the Deacon. In the persecution under the Emperor Diocletian they were first most cruelly cudgelled and recommitted to prison, where they were denied food and drink, then they were racked, and suffered long imprisonment, and lastly were beheaded, (in the year 303.)
<h>A</h>t Alexandria, under the Emperor Gallerius Maximian, the holy martyrs Mennas, Hermogenes, and Eugraphus.
<h>A</h>t Lentini, in Sicily, the holy soldiers, Mercury and his Companions, all martyrs, who were slain with the sword in the time of the Emperor Licinius, under the President Tertyllus.
<h>A</h>t Ancyra, in Galatia, the holy martyr Gemellus, who, after most grievous torments under the Emperor Julian the Apostate, achieved martyrdom by the death of the cross.
<h>A</h>t Merida, (in Estramadura,) in Spain, (in the same year,) under the Emperor Maximian, the holy Virgin and martyr Eulalia, at the age of twelve years. The President Dacian commanded her to be put to many tortures for confessing Christ at last she was hung upon the rack, and lacerated with hooks and, burning torches being put to her sides, some of the flame and smoke went down her throat and she gave up the ghost.
<h>L</h>ikewise at Merida, the holy Virgin and martyr Julia, who was a Companion of the blessed Eulalia, and the only one who clave unto her as she went to suffer.
<h>A</h>t Rome, the blessed Pope Gregory III., who passed to heaven famous for his holiness and worthy deeds.
<h>A</h>t Vienne, (about the year 650) the holy Confessor Sindulph, Bishop (of that see).
<h>A</h>t Brescia, holy Deusdedit, Bishop (of that see).
<h>A</h>t Loreto, in Picenum, is commemorated the translation, (in the year 1294) of the holy house of Mary the Mother of God, wherein the Word was made flesh.
<r>℣.</r> And elsewhere many other holy martyrs, confessors, and holy virgins.
<r>℟.</r> Thanks be to God.
